#Load Libraries:
```{r, include=FALSE}

rm(list = ls())
library(reshape2)
library(tidyplots)

library(Cairo)

```

#Set variables:
```{r, include=FALSE}

font_size <- 8
font_type <- "Helvetica Neue"

```

#Define functions:
```{r, include=FALSE}

#Define revcomp function:
revcomp <- function(seq) {
  chartr("ATCG", "TAGC", paste(rev(strsplit(seq, "")[[1]]), collapse=""))
}

```

#Load the gDNA barcode data:
```{r, include=FALSE}

gDNA_counts <- read.csv("2024_10_23_gDNA_Sequencing/Step3_40bp_Scaffold_90Match_3mm/Post_Cluster_Analysis/Organized_Data/counts_without_spike_ins.csv", row.names = 1)

#Get reverse complement for barcode names:
rownames(gDNA_counts) <- sapply(rownames(gDNA_counts), revcomp)

#Load spike-ins:
spike_in_counts <- read.csv("2024_10_23_gDNA_Sequencing/Step3_40bp_Scaffold_90Match_3mm/Post_Cluster_Analysis/Organized_Data/spike_in_counts.csv", row.names = 1)

#Get reverse complement for barcode names:
rownames(spike_in_counts) <- sapply(rownames(spike_in_counts), revcomp)

```

#Normalize using 200 cell 'rung' of spike-in ladder:
```{r, include=FALSE}

#Get 200 mean for normalization:
spike_in_200_means <- colMeans(spike_in_counts[spike_in_counts$Cell_Numbers==200,][c(1:6)])


gDNA_normalized <- data.frame( X2A = gDNA_counts$X2A/spike_in_200_means[["X2A"]], X2B = gDNA_counts$X2B/spike_in_200_means[["X2B"]] )


```

#Get dataframe using various thresholds for number of isolated barcodes:
```{r, include=FALSE}

#Test to make sure 21 is the result:
sum(gDNA_normalized$X2A >= 1 & gDNA_normalized$X2B >= 1)

sum(gDNA_normalized$X2A >= 1.5 & gDNA_normalized$X2B >= 1.5)

#Set range of normalization to check:
range_isolation_threshold <- seq(0.1, 10.1, by = 0.1)

#Create list using various thresholds:
number_of_theoretically_enriched_lineages <- sapply(range_isolation_threshold, function(t) {
  sum(gDNA_normalized$X2A >= t & gDNA_normalized$X2B >= t)
})

#Create dataframe with thresholds:
threshold_df <- data.frame(Normalized_To_200 = range_isolation_threshold, Theoretically_Enriched_Lineages = number_of_theoretically_enriched_lineages)


```

#Plot theoretically enriched lineages:
```{r}

threshold_df |> 
  tidyplot(x = Normalized_To_200, y = Theoretically_Enriched_Lineages) |>
  add_data_points(color = "black") |>
  add_reference_lines(x=1, y=21) |>
  adjust_font(fontsize = font_size, family = font_type) |>
  adjust_x_axis_title("Threshsold Relative to 200 Cell Rung") |>
  adjust_y_axis_title("Number of Lineages") |>
  adjust_x_axis(limits = c(0,NA)) |>
  adjust_y_axis(limits = c(0,max(threshold_df$Theoretically_Enriched_Lineages) * 1.1)) |>
  adjust_size(width = 1.4063, height = 1.4063, unit = "in") |>
  save_plot("2024_10_23_gDNA_Sequencing/Step3_40bp_Scaffold_90Match_3mm/Post_Cluster_Analysis/Plots/Sensitivity_Analysis_Isolated_Lineages/Scatter_Plot.pdf", device = cairo_pdf)



```
